positions.description:
Worked on strategic projects with a Focus on GTM and helped elevating our management team. Key projects include:

Development and implementation of new Pricing & Packaging for both SaaS products. Designed a differentiated product packaging and implemented a new usage-based value metric. Project responsibility ranged from analysis, design, testing to implementation. Conducted interviews and data analysis, designed new P&P approach, enabled GTM and Product teams, co-developed metering and billing system in a cross-functional project setup. Implementation led to ~10% increase in ARPA, ~20% reduction in cycle time and improvement in Proposal to Closed Won Conversion Rate.

Re-design of Sales process based on Winning-by-Design's SPICED methodology touching SDR, AE and CSM work. Changed Sales Funnel Structure, Product Positioning, Qualification Questions and Sales Collateral accompanied by 4-week enablement program with interactive sessions and workshops for GTM teams. Improved qualification quality significantly and Stabilized conversion rates and cycle times despite shrinking customer market
